hero.description: Above-the-fold hero section: kicker, title, subtitle, and CTA.

banner.description: Top announcement strip: copy, optional CTA, and dismiss.

pricing.description: Pricing section: comparison table of plans with features and CTA.

header.description: Site header / marketing navigation: logo, nav links, and CTA.

features.description: Features grid: icon, title, and description per item.

content.description: General content/prose section: long-form copy with heading hierarchy and paragraphs.

careers.description: Careers/openings section: list of open roles with title, location, and apply CTA.

footer.description: Site footer: navigation, legal links, and social links.

contact.description: Contact section: contact info and a name/email/subject/message form.

faq.description: FAQ section: list of questions and answers using the Accordion primitive.

testimonials.description: Social proof section: quote, author, and avatar in a card grid.

logos.description: Trusted-by logo strip: centered row of partner or customer logos with an optional kicker.

team.description: Team section: avatar, name, role, and bio in a grid of profile cards.

cta.description: Call-to-action section: title, optional description, and button(s).

blog-header.description: Blog header: kicker, title, subtitle, and category chips.

blog-sections.description: Post listing: card grid with category, title, excerpt, and author.

blog-post-header.description: Article header: category, title, subtitle, and author/date/read-time meta.

newsletter.description: Email subscription section with a centered heading and inline form.

marketing-stats.description: Row of featured metrics for marketing pages (editorial variant, distinct from the app dashboard's KPI block — the "stats" block).

contact-modal.description: Modal-based contact/lead capture: compact form + Dialog for direct contact.

share-invite.description: Share and invite: shareable link with copy-to-clipboard, channel/social buttons, and an email invite form with a list of pending invites.

not-found.description: 404 error section: large numeral, message, and CTA back to the site.

form-layouts.description: Application form layout: grouped sections, a responsive field grid, and an actions footer.

alerts.description: Application alerts area: info/success/warning/error messages, with dismiss and action options.

action-panels.description: Action panel: title + description rows with a single action, account/settings style, with a destructive variant.

feeds.description: Activity feed: vertical timeline with avatar, actor/action, and timestamp.

stacked-list.description: Stacked list of records: vertical cards with avatar, status badge, and action.

stats.description: Row of KPIs: metric cards with value, label, and delta.

slide-overs.description: Detail/edit slide-over: side panel with Sheet, a compact form, and Cancel/Save actions.

kpi-cards.description: Primary KPI cards: value, label, and trend indicator — the single-metric counterpart to the stats block.

table.description: Application data table: sorting, row selection, and batch actions.

application-shells.description: App frame: sidebar with navigation and user account, topbar, and content area.

modals.description: Account actions panel: row of actions that open centered dialogs (Dialog).

empty-states.description: Application empty state: icon, title, description, and CTA to create the first item.

input-groups.description: Compound inputs: prefixes, suffixes, and add-ons (URL, currency, icon, search).

app-banners.description: Application-level notifications: impersonation, trial expiring, service incident.

grid-lists.description: Card grid: responsive tile layout with thumbnail, title, subtitle, and status badge.

page-card-section-headers.description: Family of application headers: page header, card header, and section top/bottom bars.

status-monitoring.description: Service status panel: overall banner, per-service indicator and badge, uptime, and last incident.

description-list.description: Key/value detail list for record views (order, profile, etc.).

list.description: Application record list: row with avatar, primary/secondary text, status badge, and action — without Table's tabular columns.

containers.description: Page layout wrappers: max width and consistent horizontal padding (narrow, default, wide, full) for centering content.

list-containers.description: Specialized container for lists: header, scrolling body (overflow-y: auto), and footer with summary + action.

panels.description: Generic panel surfaces for grouping content: a header and a responsive grid of panels with title, body, and an optional footer action.

media-objects.description: Media + text: row with avatar (image or initials), heading, body, and optional meta — the classic 'media object' pattern for comments or activity.

product-card.description: Product card: image, sale badge, title, price, and CTA.

product-details.description: Product detail page: gallery, price, stock, variants, quantity, and add-to-cart.

store-nav.description: Store navigation: logo, category links, search, and cart with item counter.

promo.description: Sitewide promo bar: message, optional CTA, and optional dismiss button.

category-preview.description: Category tile grid: image and label linking to category pages.

category-filters.description: Sidebar faceted filters: category combobox, sizes, and price range.

product-lists.description: Product grid: section header, product cards, and simple pagination.

product-features.description: Product features grid: icon, label, and description.

reviews.description: Customer reviews: average rating summary with a star breakdown and a list of individual reviews.

shopping-cart.description: Shopping cart: product line items with image, quantity, and remove option, subtotal, and checkout CTA.

checkout-forms.description: Checkout form: shipping address and payment details grouped in a multi-section form.

order-summaries.description: Order summary: product line items with quantity, subtotal, shipping, tax, and total. Read-only.

order-history.description: Order history: list of past orders with status, date, and total, each linking to its detail page.

incentives.description: Trust incentives strip: free shipping, easy exchanges and returns, and secure payment, each with an icon and short description.

portfolio-header.description: Portfolio header: avatar, name, role, bio, links, and CTA.

portfolio-sections.description: Work showcase: project grid with image, category, and case-study link.

long-form-content.description: Case study / long-form reading layout: kicker, headline, dek, cover image, and prose sections with a pull-quote.

story.description: Vertical 9:16 template for ads / stories: kicker, title, and CTA.

sign-in.description: Sign-in screen: email/password, remember me, forgot password, and a link to sign up.

sign-up.description: Sign-up screen: name, email, password, confirmation, and terms acceptance.

forgot-password.description: Forgot-password screen: asks for the email and confirms the link was sent.

reset-password.description: Screen for choosing a new password after verifying the recovery code.

verify.description: Code verification (OTP) screen: confirms the email address or the password reset.

welcome.description: Welcome screen: first step of onboarding, greeting message, and CTA to get started. Composes no block — primitives only.

profile-setup.description: Profile setup screen: composes the form-layouts block (name, email, bio, role, and timezone).

plan-select.description: Plan/workspace selection screen: composes the grid-lists block — each plan tile reuses its title/subtitle/status-badge card.

invite-team.description: Team invite screen: composes the list block for invitee rows, alongside its own email form + add button.

referral-invite.description: Starting screen of the Referral flow: its own form with the user's name and a CTA to generate the referral link — composes no block.

referral-share.description: Share screen of the Referral flow (cross-domain Applications + Marketing): composes the Marketing share-invite block for the link, channel buttons, and the email invite form.

referral-reward.description: Final screen of the Referral flow: summary of accumulated reward, list of invitees with their status, and a claim CTA — composes no block.

cart.description: Cart screen: line items with quantity and remove option, subtotal, and a CTA to continue to shipping. Composes the shopping-cart block. Can also be added standalone.

shipping.description: Shipping address and payment screen: composes the checkout-forms block (address + card in a single form).

payment.description: Payment method screen: re-presents the checkout-forms block, pre-filled with the shipping values, to confirm or adjust the card.

review.description: Order review screen: composes the order-summaries block (read-only) alongside the screen's own shipping/payment summary.

confirmation.description: Order confirmation screen: success message, order number, and a CTA to keep shopping. Composes no block — primitives only.

auth.description: Complete authentication flow: sign-in, sign-up, password recovery and reset, and code verification, with a local-state example assembly.

checkout.description: Complete checkout flow — the E-Commerce capstone: cart, shipping, payment, review, and confirmation, with a local-state example assembly. The first time a flow's screens compose E-Commerce blocks (shopping-cart, checkout-forms, order-summaries) instead of just primitives, exercising the recursive resolution of `composes`.

onboarding.description: Complete onboarding flow — the Applications capstone: welcome, profile, plan/workspace selection, and team invite, with a local-state example assembly. The screens compose the Applications form-layouts, grid-lists, and list blocks instead of just primitives, exercising the recursive resolution of `composes`.

referral.description: Referral flow — cross-domain (Applications + Marketing), the last one out: invite (generate your link), share (composes the Marketing share-invite block), and reward/claim, with a local-state example assembly. The `referral-share` screen composes the share-invite block instead of reimplementing its UI, exercising the recursive resolution of `composes` across domains.
